versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the review-structure skill focused on repo-wide structural and maintainability review.
- Enforces anti-confabulation by requiring evidence and verbatim citation of all review targets before issuing findings.
- Introduces hard, artifact-backed gates: changed-file detection, full-file reads with line counts, and verifiable claims for helper existence and file-size thresholds.
- Mandates rigorous structural standards: pushes for ambitious simplification, restricts file growth past 1,000 lines, bans spaghetti code, promotes canonical-layer logic, and enforces overt boundary/type contracts.
- Reviewers are prompted to pursue significant, systemic improvements—"code judo" restructurings—beyond routine cleanup.
